notes_for_editor: The only source is the Eastern US Lookouts page, which gives the name and county and nothing else. The record point (30.9872, -86.9696) comes from that site's map widget, not from the page text, so it could not be checked against a quote. Two searches (Santa Rosa County, Blackwater River State Forest, Florida Forest Service) found no lookout of this name. A 1940 Florida State Road Department map of the middle of Santa Rosa County (https://fcit.usf.edu/florida/maps/pages/2700/f2756/f2756z.htm) lists a fire tower and camps but names neither, and its coverage may not reach the record point, which lies near the county's northern edge; it is not used in the story. Worth checking: Florida Forest Service Blackwater Forestry Center records and State Archives of Florida photos for the name. Status and access stay unknown.
